people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up Yahweh’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
translations.bsb: And David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to the place he had prepared for it.
translations.kjv: And David gathered ➔ all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
translations.asv: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Jehovah unto its place, which he had prepared for it.
